# Connector reference

**21 integrations.** None of them is required: the
platform crawls and audits any public site with nothing connected, and
every capability that is unavailable is reported as unavailable rather
than silently skipped.

## What each one unlocks

| Provider | Category | Auth | Unlocks |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Google Search Console** | search | `oauth2` | Real keyword targets instead of guesses, striking-distance opportunities, click-through gaps, and proof that what we shipped worked |
| **Google Analytics 4** | analytics | `oauth2` | Reporting in revenue rather than rankings, and content decisions based on what converts |
| **Google Business Profile** | local | `oauth2` | Automated weekly posts, drafted review replies, profile completeness fixes, map pack tracking |
| **WordPress** | cms | `app_password` | Approved content goes live by itself, and on-page fixes apply without a developer |
| **Shopify** | cms | `token` | Product and collection copy, SEO metafields, merchant listing fixes |
| **Webflow** | cms | `token` | Blog and resource content published into your collections |
| **Ghost** | cms | `api_key` | Scheduled publishing with full control of meta and canonical tags |
| **GitHub (static site)** | cms | `token` | Content arrives as a pull request, so your own review and CI gates apply before anything goes live |
| **DataForSEO** | data | `basic` | Competitor analysis, keyword research at scale, geo-grid local rank tracking |
| **Moz** | data | `basic` | Link prospect qualification and authority benchmarking |
| **Bing Webmaster Tools** | search | `api_key` | Visibility on the index that feeds Copilot, and faster recrawls |
| **IndexNow** | search | `api_key` | Minutes-not-days recrawl after every publish. Free, no account needed. |
| **Your mail server (SMTP)** | outreach | `basic` | Link building and digital PR that actually gets opened |
| **LinkedIn** | social | `oauth2` | Distribution for published content, which is how new pages earn their first links |
| **PageSpeed Insights** | performance | `api_key` | Performance diagnosis for your site and for competitors |

## Google Search Console  `google_search_console`

The queries, pages and indexing state Google actually sees

**Unlocks:** Real keyword targets instead of guesses, striking-distance opportunities, click-through gaps, and proof that what we shipped worked

**Configuration**

| Field | Label | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `site_url` | Property | yes | Chosen after you connect |

[Provider documentation](https://search.google.com/search-console)

## Google Analytics 4  `google_analytics_4`

Sessions, conversions and revenue by landing page

**Unlocks:** Reporting in revenue rather than rankings, and content decisions based on what converts

**Configuration**

| Field | Label | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `property_id` | Property | yes |  |

## Google Business Profile  `google_business_profile`

Listings, posts, reviews and Q&A for physical locations

**Unlocks:** Automated weekly posts, drafted review replies, profile completeness fixes, map pack tracking

> Google requires a one-off manual approval before any project gets Business Profile API quota, and new projects start at zero. Until it is granted, local work still runs and the platform prepares posts and replies for you to paste in.

## WordPress  `wordpress`

Publish and edit through the WordPress REST API

**Unlocks:** Approved content goes live by itself, and on-page fixes apply without a developer

**Credentials**

| Field | Label | Required | Secret | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | WordPress username | yes | no |  |
| `application_password` | Application password | yes | yes | Users -> Profile -> Application Passwords. Revoke it any time. |

**Configuration**

| Field | Label | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `site_url` | Site URL | yes |  |

[Provider documentation](https://wordpress.org/documentation/article/application-passwords/)

## GitHub (static site)  `github`

Next.js, Astro, Hugo, Jekyll and any repo-backed site

**Unlocks:** Content arrives as a pull request, so your own review and CI gates apply before anything goes live

**Credentials**

| Field | Label | Required | Secret | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | Personal access token | yes | yes | Needs contents:write and pull_requests:write on the one repo |

**Configuration**

| Field | Label | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `repo` | Repository | yes |  |
| `base_branch` | Base branch | no |  |
| `content_dir` | Content directory | no |  |
| `extension` | File extension | no |  |

## IndexNow  `indexnow`

Push changed URLs to Bing, Yandex, Seznam and Naver

**Unlocks:** Minutes-not-days recrawl after every publish. Free, no account needed.

> You will need to upload one text file to your site root; the platform generates it.

**Credentials**

| Field | Label | Required | Secret | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | IndexNow key | yes | no | Any 8 to 128 character string you choose |

**Configuration**

| Field | Label | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | Host | yes |  |

## Your mail server (SMTP)  `smtp`

Send outreach from your own domain

**Unlocks:** Link building and digital PR that actually gets opened

> Outreach always leaves from your domain, never from ours, and never in bulk.

**Credentials**

| Field | Label | Required | Secret | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | SMTP host | yes | no |  |
| `port` | Port | no | no |  |
| `username` | Username | yes | no |  |
| `password` | Password | yes | yes |  |

**Configuration**

| Field | Label | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from_email` | From address | yes |  |
| `from_name` | From name | no |  |

## LinkedIn  `linkedin`

Company page posting

**Unlocks:** Distribution for published content, which is how new pages earn their first links

> Company pages only. The platform never automates personal profiles or direct messages.

**Configuration**

| Field | Label | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_urn` | Company page | yes |  |

## PageSpeed Insights  `pagespeed`

Lab and field Core Web Vitals for any URL

**Unlocks:** Performance diagnosis for your site and for competitors

**Credentials**

| Field | Label | Required | Secret | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `api_key` | Google API key | no | yes | Optional. Without one, requests are rate limited but still work. |
